content.title: MLB Sunday Night Baseball Full 2026 Schedule on NBC & Peacock: Dodgers, Yankees & More
content.text: Batter up! Major League Baseball is swinging back to NBC!How to WatchWatch Sunday Night Baseball on NBC and Peacock.In an awesome new broadcast package that introduces Sunday Night Baseball as a prime time complement to Sunday Night Football and Sunday Night Basketball, the MLB on NBC and Peacock is cracking the bats for a springtime debut that will deliver a mind-blowing broadcast network first: NBC Sports action on the same game night every week — and happening in prime time all year 'round.Now, we’ve got a complete preview of all the Sunday Night Baseball games coming to NBC and Peacock for the 2026 MLB season. Beginning March 29 when the Cleveland Guardians visit the Seattle Mariners for a matchup between American League division winners, it’s a stacked Sunday baseball slate that stretches all the way until Sunday Night Football kicks off in September… so keep on scrolling for all the need-to-know details!RELATED: Sports Broadcasting Legend Bob Costas Returns to NBC for Sunday Night Baseball (DETAILS)NBC’s Sunday Night Baseball lineup of games is part of an even bigger package of 2026 MLB action. In addition to weekly Sunday Night Baseball, this season's NBC Sports MLB schedule also includes weekly afternoon matchups, special MLB programming (like a full day of July 5 baseball on “Star-Spangled Sunday”), and exclusive postseason coverage of the entire Wild Card round on NBC, Peacock, and NBCSN (the NBC Sports Network). Want to get a big bird’s’-eye overview of NBC Sports’ entire 2026 MLB game plan? Click here! (Peacock)RELATED: Sunday Night Baseball: Full 2026 Schedule for MLB Games on NBC & PeacockAs you can see from the schedule above, Peacock’s the exclusive place to catch early-season Sunday Night Baseball action up until May 31, when NBC also joins the broadcasting mix after Sunday Night Basketball and the NBA postseason wind down. All summer long from May 31 through September 6, Sunday Night Baseball will take over the Sunday evening prime time slot on NBC (while always remaining available to watch live on Peacock). From there, things switch over to Peacock exclusively once more, after NBC Sports kicks off a new NFL season of Sunday Night Football in prime time on NBC.
